versions.changelog:
Initial release of openclaw-magika:

- Adds AI-powered file type detection using Google Magika (supports 200+ types with ~99% accuracy).
- Triggers on user requests to identify, check, or detect file types, as well as during analysis of uploaded or batch files.
- All file analysis is performed locally for privacy—no data is sent to third parties.
- Requires Magika CLI (installable via pip, pipx, or brew); no config files needed.
- Provides clear command examples for single files, MIME types, batch operations, and confidence scores.
